— Web design & development

A website that makes the next step clear.

Your website should explain your business clearly and help visitors act with confidence. I bring marketing, content, and development together to create sites that are useful to people and straightforward to maintain.

Discuss web design & development

A connected approach to web design & development

A website project begins with the information visitors need, not a choice of effects or templates. The navigation, page hierarchy, service descriptions, and contact journey should fit the business. Technical choices then support those needs: a content-led professional site may work well as a lean static build, while a store or a complex publishing workflow needs different capabilities. The right solution balances functionality, speed, maintainability, and cost.

When this work can help

  • The current website is slow, confusing, or difficult to update.
  • A redesign looks better but still fails to explain the offering.
  • Forms, analytics, and search visibility have been treated as separate afterthoughts.

How I approach the work

I clarify the business goals, audience, essential content, and publishing responsibilities. A page plan and key user journeys guide design before development. During implementation, responsive behavior, keyboard use, metadata, performance, and contact handling are checked together. Launch planning includes redirects, domain configuration, and ownership of the systems the business will rely on.

Core activities & deliverables

Structure and content

Plan navigation, page purpose, and calls to action. Identify the real facts, images, and approvals needed to complete the site without invented portfolio work or placeholder claims.

Responsive implementation

Develop reusable layouts, accessible interactions, and efficient assets. Choose technologies suited to the requirements and avoid dependencies that add maintenance without a practical benefit.

Launch and handover

Test representative devices, forms, direct URLs, search metadata, and error handling. Document editing, deployment, backups where relevant, and the boundary between ongoing maintenance and project delivery.

Who this is for

This service suits businesses creating a professional presence, replacing a dated site, or improving a site that no longer reflects the offering. Scope can range from a focused service website to a structured content site or e-commerce project. Existing hosting, integrations, accessibility requirements, and ownership arrangements should be reviewed early because they affect both delivery and future maintenance.

What to consider before starting

A website alone does not create demand or guarantee inquiries. Content approvals, third-party services, domain access, and platform limitations can affect launch timing. Accessibility and security require ongoing attention as content and integrations change; a project should not claim permanent compliance or immunity from attacks. Hosting and provider costs need to be identified before launch.

How we assess progress

Useful checks include whether priority journeys can be completed, whether important pages render quickly, whether search systems can read the content, and whether genuine inquiries are recorded accurately. Performance is measured on the actual implementation rather than asserted from a template. After launch, customer feedback and analytics can guide focused improvements.

Questions about web design & development

Will the website work on mobile?+

Responsive layouts and representative mobile checks are part of the development approach. Device coverage and any specialized requirements are agreed within scope.

Can you improve an existing site?+

Yes. An initial review can establish whether targeted improvements or a rebuild best fits the problems, platform, and budget.
